lines.en: label halloweenfive3:
scene chikayumihallow1
: Hey...I didn’t...realize you’d be coming this year.
lines.zh: : 嘿……我没……想到你今年也会来。

lines.en: : And I didn’t realize you were capable of talking to me without threatening my life anymore.
lines.zh: : 我也没想到你现在能不威胁我的性命、好好跟我说话了。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow2
: Yeaaaaah...sorry about that. That was a...weird thing that happened.
lines.zh: : 是、是啊……那事抱歉。那是……一件挺奇怪的事。

lines.en: : I ain’t sure “weird” really summarizes it, but aight.
lines.zh: : 我不确定「奇怪」能不能概括得了，不过行吧。

lines.en: : I feel like I’m missing valuable context here.
lines.zh: : 我感觉我错过了重要的背景信息。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow3
: I feel like it might be time for you to fuck off, nerd.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你该他妈滚一边去了，书呆子。

lines.en: : Weren’t you just telling me a minute ago that making people feel small doesn’t feel good? What happened to the big sentimental moment we just had?
lines.zh: : 你不是一分钟前还在跟我说让别人觉得自己渺小不好受吗？我们刚那段煽情时刻怎么了？

lines.en: : Beats me, four-eyes. I gotta make time for another one I guess.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢，四眼。我大概得再腾出时间来一段。

lines.en: : Four-eyes? But I’m not even wearing my glasses today.
lines.zh: : 四眼？可我今天根本没戴眼镜啊。

lines.en: : Sorry, Makoto...can I borrow Yumi for a minute? I get that you guys are still decorating and stuff, so I promise it won’t take long.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Makoto……能借 Yumi 一会儿吗？我知道你们还在布置什么的，我保证不会太久。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow4
: Just keep her. Yumi wasn’t really helping at all and we’re practically done here anyway.
lines.zh: : 干脆留着她吧。Yumi 根本没帮上什么忙，而且我们这边基本也弄完了。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay. Sorry again, though.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。不过还是抱歉啊。

lines.en: : I ain’t gonna follow you just to get the shit kicked out of me, am I? Cause I get that you hate me and whatnot now, but fuckin’ me up on my birthday seems like a bit of a low blow.
lines.zh: : 我不会是跟着你走、然后被人打得半死吧？我知道你现在恨我什么的，但在我生日这天把我揍一顿好像有点太下作了。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow5
: Oh, crap. I totally forgot it was your birthday.
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了。我完全忘了今天是你生日。

lines.en: : Good. Why are you still here?
lines.zh: : 很好。那你怎么还在这儿？

lines.en: : You’re in my way. I need to finish setting up the second jack-o-lantern. And if it’s not absolutely perfectly positioned, I will consider myself a failure for the rest of eternity. Literally.
lines.zh: : 你挡我路了。我得把第二个南瓜灯摆完。如果它没有被摆得绝对完美，我会在剩下的永恒里把自己当成失败者。字面意义上。

lines.en: : Come on, Yumi. We can talk outside. I promise I won’t try to throw you off of a building this time.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Yumi。我们可以出去谈。我保证这次不会把你从楼上扔下去。

lines.en: : Just what the hell happened between you two?
lines.zh: : 你们俩到底发生了什么？

lines.en: scene black
: A whole lotta bullshit, that’s what. But hey, here’s hopin’ the universe makes me forget it or whatever.
lines.zh: : 一大堆破事，就这么简单。不过嘿，就指望宇宙让我忘了那些或者什么的吧。

lines.en: : Also, since I kinda fear for my life right now, you don’t happen to know what goes down when somebody dies in this shit, do you?
lines.zh: : 还有，鉴于我现在有点担心自己小命，你知不知道在这种破地方人死了会怎么样？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. Let me call my dad and find out.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。我打个电话问我爸。

lines.en: : Oh, fuck. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，操。抱歉。

lines.en: : What are you guys talking about? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 你们在说什么？我听不懂。

lines.en: : Yeah, you wouldn’t. Come on.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你当然不懂。走了。

lines.en: : Let’s get this shit over with.
lines.zh: : 赶紧把这破事办完吧。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow6
Back outside, where the light still lives — two friends (?) find their places among the foliage.
lines.zh: 回到外面，光还活着的地方——两个朋友（？）在树丛间各自找到了位置。

lines.en: But the birthday girl is apprehensive. Because despite being accustomed to the ones she loves abandoning her, she isn’t used to them coming back so quickly.
lines.zh: 但寿星很不安。因为尽管她早已习惯被自己所爱的人抛弃，却不习惯他们这么快就回来。

lines.en: Something had changed within Chika, though. And it was {i}this{/i} thought that made her entirely uncertain whether or not she even {i}was{/i} coming back.
lines.zh: 不过 Chika 心里已经发生了变化。正是{i}这个{/i}念头让她完全不确定自己到底算不算回来了。

lines.en: She was flashing her those same sympathetic, caring eyes she always had. But words like “whore” still lingered in the back of her mind and made her feel both regretful and dirty.
lines.zh: 她还是用那双一如既往充满同情与关怀的眼睛看着她。可「婊子」之类的词仍萦绕在她脑海深处，让她既后悔又肮脏。

lines.en: She hadn’t done anything wrong {i}yet.{/i} But she understood that the mere {i}possibility{/i} of doing something wrong made her actions (or inactions) wrong to Chika.
lines.zh: 她{i}还{/i}什么都没做错。但她明白，仅仅是「{i}可能{/i}做错」这一点，就让她的一切行为（或不作为）在 Chika 眼里都是错的。

lines.en: Yumi agreed — which is why she wouldn’t put up a fight if her former (or current?) friend really {i}did{/i} want to give her a birthday beatdown.
lines.zh: Yumi 也同意——所以如果她那位前（或现任？）朋友{i}真的{/i}想在生日这天揍她一顿，她也不会反抗。

lines.en: That friend (?) had other plans, though.
lines.zh: 不过那位朋友（？）另有打算。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow7
Her disease had already set in by now. She’d never again be able to swallow the sea as the mere thought of water made her foam from the mouth.
lines.zh: 她的病到这时已经发作了。她再也无法吞咽大海，光是想到水就会口吐白沫。

lines.en: As she’d started showing symptoms, it was already too late for her. But she could still infect others. She could take her friend (?) down with her.
lines.zh: 等她开始出现症状时，对她来说已经太迟了。但她仍然能感染别人。她可以把她的朋友（？）一起拖下水。

lines.en: She bares her teeth and prepares to sink her fangs in.
lines.zh: 她龇出牙齿，准备把尖牙咬进去。

lines.en: : Let me start off by saying I am {i}so{/i} sorry for the way I treated you, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 首先我想说，我为我那样对待你感到{i}非常{/i}抱歉，Yumi。

lines.en: But she sinks them in gently. Gentle enough to not signal to the birthday girl that she’s been bitten.
lines.zh: 但她轻轻地咬了下去。轻到没让寿星察觉自己已经被咬了。

lines.en: : You’re...what?
lines.zh: : 你……什么？

lines.en: : Sorry. I went way overboard back at the apartment. It was the culmination of a lot of anxiety I’ve been having lately and...knowing it was {i}you{/i} just sent me over the edge.
lines.zh: : 对不起。我在公寓那次太过分了。那是我最近积累的一大堆焦虑的总爆发，而且……知道那人是{i}你{/i}就直接把我逼过了界。

lines.en: : I love you, Yumi. Seriously.
lines.zh: : 我爱你，Yumi。真的。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow8
: Is there some kinda catch here? Because-
lines.zh: : 这里面有什么陷阱吧？因为——

lines.en: : No! Nothing like that. I just...didn’t really understand what was happening back then. But I’ve had time to think about it now, and I get it. You were never trying to hurt me. You were just confused.
lines.zh: : 没有！没有那种事。我只是……当时不太明白发生了什么。但现在我有了时间思考，我懂了。你从来没想过要伤害我。你只是迷茫。

lines.en: : I’m confused now too. The fuck did that creeper say to you that made you flip-flop like it was fuckin’ nothing?
lines.zh: : 我现在也迷茫。那个变态到底跟你说了什么，能让你像翻书一样说变就变？

lines.en: : You said it yourself that even if I was tellin’ the truth that shit wasn’t lookin’ good for me. And you were right. A hundred fuckin’ percent. I screwed up by lettin’ myself get close to that guy. Ain’t no way around it.
lines.zh: : 你自己也说过，就算我说的是实话，那情况对我来说也不好看。而你是对的。百分之百。我错就错在让自己跟那个男的走得太近。没得辩。

lines.en: : You didn’t screw up, Yumi. Some people just have different ideas of what “love” really is.
lines.zh: : 你没有做错，Yumi。只是有些人对「爱」到底是什么有不一样的想法。

lines.en: : Some people...what?
lines.zh: : 有些人……什么？

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow9

: Think of it like this — monogamy hasn’t {i}always{/i} been expected or even {i}normal{/i} in society. In fact, love and sex were practically {i}unlinked{/i} at first. Some say even the gods themselves got around.
lines.zh: : 这么想吧——一夫一妻在社会上并不{i}一直{/i}被期待，甚至不是{i}常态{/i}。事实上，爱和性在最开始几乎是{i}脱钩{/i}的。有人说连神明自己都很滥交。

lines.en: : Are you fuckin’ high right now? The hell are you on about?
lines.zh: : 你他妈现在嗑嗨了吧？你到底在说什么鬼？

lines.en: : You’re not {i}listening.{/i} This is me admitting that I’ve been looking at things all wrong. I expected everyone else to think of love the same way {i}I{/i} did, but it’s been {i}me{/i} who’s been wrong.
lines.zh: : {i}你没在听。{/i}这是我在承认我一直以来看事情的角度都错了。我以前指望别人都跟{i}我{/i}想的一样去理解爱，但一直错的是{i}我自己{/i}。

lines.en: : With so many wonderful people all over the world and so many things to {i}love{/i} about each and every one of them, {i}of course{/i} loving just {i}one{/i} person would be wrong. It doesn’t make sense.
lines.zh: : 世界上有那么多美好的人，每个人身上又有那么多值得{i}爱{/i}的东西，{i}当然{/i}只爱{i}一个{/i}人才是错的。这说不通。

lines.en: : There are all different types of love out there and not {i}all{/i} of them are created equally. All pigeonholing someone into ignoring those other feelings does is make them think you’re undeserving.
lines.zh: : 世上有各式各样的爱，而它们{i}并非{/i}生而平等。把一个人硬塞进框里、逼他无视那些别的感情，只会让他觉得你不配。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow10
: Life is a learning experience, Yumi. You can never really grow until you start seeing things from other people’s perspectives.
lines.zh: : 人生就是一个学习的过程，Yumi。不开始从别人的角度看问题，你就永远无法真正成长。

lines.en: : So I {i}get it{/i} now. And I feel totally ridiculous for ever questioning Sensei in the first place. I just didn’t see at the time how many different ways to {i}love{/i} there were. But now that I do, I’m a better person.
lines.zh: : 所以我现在{i}懂了{/i}。而且我为自己当初竟然质疑过 Sensei 感到荒谬。只是当时我没看到{i}爱{/i}有那么多不同的方式。但现在我看到了，所以我是个更好的人了。

lines.en: : I’m beginnin’ to think that motherfucker didn’t even show up and you’ve just been left in your apartment to rot and go insane since then.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得那个混蛋根本没出现，你从那以后就一直被扔在公寓里烂掉、发疯了。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow11

: It’s okay. You don’t have to understand it right now. You’re still inexperienced. But take it from me — love only {i}seems{/i} complicated at first, but it’s actually really simple. And {i}that’s{/i} why I forgive you.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你现在不必理解。你还太没经验。但听我说——爱一开始{i}看起来{/i}复杂，其实非常简单。{i}所以{/i}我原谅你。

lines.en: : Uhh...I still ain’t really got a fuckin’ clue what you’re tryin’ to say here, but...so long as you’re sayin’ we’re on good terms again, I...guess it doesn’t really matter?
lines.zh: : 呃……我还是他妈完全没搞懂你想说什么，不过……只要你是说我们和好了，我……想也就不重要了吧？

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow12
: Right.
: And {i}also{/i} why you can go ahead and pursue Sensei in any way you want since I know that his love for {i}me{/i} is the strongest.
lines.zh: : 还有，这{i}也{/i}是为什么你可以随心所欲地去追 Sensei，因为我知道他对{i}我{/i}的爱是最强的。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow13
: The fuck you mean “pursue” him?! That shit sounds like you’re tryin’ to hook me up with the guy!
lines.zh: : 你他妈说「追」他是什么意思？！这话听着像是你要把我和那家伙撮合到一起！

lines.en: : I mean, I’m not {i}trying{/i} to. But if your feelings for one another are strong enough to be considered “love” by any stretch, I no longer see a problem with it!
lines.zh: : 我不是在{i}撮合{/i}。但如果你们对彼此的感情强到能被称为「爱」的话，我就不再觉得有什么问题了！

lines.en: : Please tell me you hid your fuckin’ drugs from Chinami because this shit is {i}scary,{/i} Chika.
lines.zh: : 拜托告诉我你把那些药藏起来没让 Chinami 找到，因为这太{i}吓人{/i}了，Chika。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow14

: It’s not {i}scary,{/i} it’s just different. Sensei told me very clearly that he would choose me over anyone if he really had to. And I believe him because that’s what {i}love{/i} is. It’s just “love” for everyone else.
lines.zh: : 这不{i}可怕{/i}，只是不一样。Sensei 说得很清楚，如果真要选，他会选我而不是任何人。我相信他，因为那就是{i}爱{/i}。对其他人只是「爱」而已。

lines.en: : {i}Love{/i} and “love” are the same fuckin’ word, dumbass.
lines.zh: : {i}爱{/i}和「爱」是他妈同一个词，蠢货。

lines.en: : Same word — different meanings.
lines.zh: : 同一个词——不同的意思。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow15
: If it helps you understand, why not look at Sensei like a god and {i}me{/i} as his goddess?! As deities together, we love all of our subjects! We just love {i}each other{/i} the most!
lines.zh: : 如果这样好理解一点，你何不把 Sensei 看成神、把{i}我{/i}看成他的女神？！作为一对神明，我们爱我们所有的信徒！我们只是最爱{i}彼此{/i}！

lines.en: : Did he fuckin’ {i}brainwash{/i} you?...You seriously ain’t got a problem with that, Chika? That’s totally different from literally everything you’ve ever-
lines.zh: : 他是不是给你{i}洗脑{/i}了？……你真的对这没意见吗，Chika？这跟你以前所有的想法完全——

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow16
: I wasn’t {i}brainwashed.{/i} I’ve just grown. And sometimes, when people grow, they start looking at the world a little differently.
lines.zh: : 我{i}没被洗脑{/i}。我只是成长了。而人成长的时候，有时候看世界的方式就会有点不一样。

lines.en: : You’ll get there one day, Yumi. You’re an amazing girl and I’m positive that one day, you’ll find your {i}own{/i} Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你总有一天也会走到那一步的，Yumi。你是个了不起的女孩，我相信有一天你会找到属于你{i}自己{/i}的 Sensei。

lines.en: : But until then, you can let {i}mine{/i} share some of his infinite love with you.
lines.zh: : 但在那之前，你可以让{i}我的{/i} Sensei 把他无限的爱分你一些。

lines.en: : Gtyrfngroffmymth.
lines.zh: : Gtyrfngroffmymth.

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow17
: Sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : Without beatin’ around the bush...you’re suddenly okay with your “boyfriend” fucking other girls?
lines.zh: : 不拐弯抹角地说……你突然就接受你「男朋友」去操别的女生了？

lines.en: : Only if he loves them.
lines.zh: : 只要他爱她们。

lines.en: : Well, how the fuck do you know if he loves them?
lines.zh: : 那他妈你怎么知道他爱不爱她们？

lines.en: : By trusting him, obviously.
lines.zh: : 当然是靠信任他。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow18
: Chika, you’re fucking delusional!
lines.zh: : Chika，你他妈疯了！

lines.en: : Don’t call me delusional just because you aren’t mature enough to understand love yet! You’ve gotta remember, I was also like that until recently!
lines.zh: : 别因为你还不够成熟、理解不了爱就说我疯了！别忘了，我直到最近也跟你一样！

lines.en: : Yeah! But now you’ve gone and snapped and rewritten everything you’ve ever thought about love over some shit that asshole said to you!
lines.zh: : 对啊！可你现在已经崩坏了，因为那个混蛋跟你说的几句话就把你对爱的所有想法都改写了！

lines.en: : Hey, don’t call Sensei an asshole when you two have practically already had sex behind my back!
lines.zh: : 嘿，别叫 Sensei 混蛋——你们俩背着我差不多都已经上过床了吧！

lines.en: : We have fucking not!
lines.zh: : 我们他妈才没有！

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow19
: But now you {i}can!{/i} And everyone wins — especially me since I’m winning.
lines.zh: : 但现在你们{i}可以了{/i}！大家都赢——尤其是我，因为我在赢。

lines.en: : Winning {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 赢{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Sensei, obviously. I’m his number one girl and the one he loves the most. And one day, we’re going to get married and have a bunch of kids and live happily ever after. The end.
lines.zh: : 当然是 Sensei。我是他的头号女孩，是他最爱的人。总有一天我们会结婚、生一堆孩子、幸福快乐地过一辈子。完。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow20
: Now, let me tell you how he likes his dick sucked so you don’t embarrass yourself the first time you try. You can start by-
lines.zh: : 现在，让我告诉你他喜欢别人怎么给他口，免得你第一次试的时候丢人。你可以先——

lines.en: : I don’t want to hear it...
lines.zh: : 我不想听……

lines.en: scene black
: Yumi? Where are you going?
lines.zh: : Yumi？你要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Back inside. I came out here to talk to Chika, not whoever the fuck {i}this{/i} is.
lines.zh: : 回屋里去。我是出来跟 Chika 说话的，不是跟{i}这个{/i}他妈不知道是谁的东西。

lines.en: : I’m still me! I just have a new lease on life! Don’t you want to learn how to give a blowjob?!
lines.zh: : 我还是我啊！我只是获得了新生！你不想学怎么口交吗？！

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow21
: Ya ever wonder why Ayane’s got so many friggin’ Halloween decorations? There’s some stuff in here that’s weird as heck.
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过 Ayane 家怎么会有这么多万圣节装饰？这里有些东西诡异得要命。

lines.en: : I’ve found like fifteen guns already.
lines.zh: : 我已经找到差不多十五把枪了。

lines.en: : That’s it? Figured there would be more.
lines.zh: : 就这？我还以为会更多。

lines.en: : Sixteen, actually. I can see a pistol inside of this pumpkin now that I’m looking a little closer.
lines.zh: : 其实是十六把。我再仔细看看，能看见这个南瓜里有把手枪。

lines.en: : Friggin’ rich people, man. Always heard money buys power, but I didn’t think that was about actual weapons.
lines.zh: : 他妈的有钱人啊。一直听说金钱买得到权力，但我没想到是真的拿去买武器。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow22
: It is what it is. At least we can be happy that she’s a responsible gun owner.
lines.zh: : 就这样吧。至少我们可以庆幸她是个负责任的枪主。

lines.en: : She brings them to school.
lines.zh: : 她还把枪带到学校去。

lines.en: : Yeah, but every single one of her murders has been with some sort of ball.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过她的每一次谋杀用的都是某种球。

lines.en: : Speakin’ of balls, you ever break your vagina before?
lines.zh: : 说到球，你有没有把阴道弄伤过？

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow23
: I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 抱歉？

lines.en: : Like by puttin’ somethin’ up there way too big for it. Pretty normal thing, I hear. Happens to like nine out of ten girls.
lines.zh: : 比如往里面塞了个太大的东西。我听说挺常见的。十个女生里有九个吧。

lines.en: : I mean...is that really {i}breaking{/i} it, though?
lines.zh: : 我意思是……那真算{i}弄伤{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Blood everywhere. Constant pain. Hurts to pee for the next week. You know how it is, right?
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。到处都是血。一直疼。接下来一个星期尿尿都疼。你懂的吧？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Is everything okay, Miku? Did you...somehow break your vagina? Do you...require medical assistance?
lines.zh: : Miku，你还好吗？你是不是……不知怎么把阴道弄伤了？你……需要医疗救助吗？

lines.en: : Me? Pfft. No. I’m Monkey D. Luffy. No vagina here. Just a cool hat and a stretchy wiener.
lines.zh: : 我？噗。没有。我是 Monkey D. Luffy。我这儿没有阴道。只有一顶帅帽子和一个能伸缩的香肠。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow24
: You’re a weird girl. But I won’t lie — it’s been fun getting to know you a little better today. Even if some of your questions have been extremely unconventional and oddly personal.
lines.zh: : 你真是个奇怪的女孩。不过说实话——今天能多了解你一点挺开心的。就算你的一些问题非常不合常规、而且莫名地私人。

lines.en: : Yeah. We ain’t ever really talked much, have we?
lines.zh: : 是啊。我们其实从来没怎么聊过，对吧？

lines.en: : Not about anything deep, at least. But it’s not like we need to know everything about one another to become-
lines.zh: : 至少没聊过什么深入的东西。但我们也不是非得知道对方的一切才能变成——

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow25
: Huh?
: How do we become “huh” exactly? I ain’t sure what that means.
lines.zh: : 怎么「嗯」？我不太明白那是什么意思。

lines.en: : Sorry. What I meant to say was, “Huh? There’s a box in here with Ami’s name on it.”
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我想说的是，「嗯？这里面有个盒子，上面写着 Ami 的名字。」

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow26
: Ami? What’s in it? Somebody’s intestines? Strawberry milk? Pictures of Sensei? Move over. I can’t see.
lines.zh: : Ami？里面是什么？谁的肠子？草莓牛奶？Sensei 的照片？让开，我看不见。

lines.en: : Looks like it’s pictures of...
lines.zh: : 看起来是……

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow27
: Us? Lemme see. My clothes are on, right? Cause I’m chargin’ for nudes.
lines.zh: : 我们？让我看看。我衣服是穿着的吧？因为裸照是要收费的。

lines.en: : That’s...so weird...
lines.zh: : 这……太诡异了……

lines.en: : I don’t remember taking {i}any{/i} of these...
lines.zh: : 我不记得拍过这些……

lines.en: : The heck are you wearin’ there? I don’t recognize that costume.
lines.zh: : 你那穿的是什么鬼？那套服装我没见过。

lines.en: : Yeah...neither do I.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我也没见过。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow28
: Well hello, Molly. Hello, Tsuneyo. Please do not mind me. I’m just looking at the ceiling for no reason whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 嗨呀，Molly。你好，Tsuneyo。请别在意我。我只是毫无理由地在看天花板。

lines.en: : You sure are...{i}fit,{/i} Tsuneyo. I wish I had the confidence or body to wear something like that.
lines.zh: : 你身材真的……{i}很好{/i}，Tsuneyo。真希望我也有那份自信、或者那副身材来穿那种衣服。

lines.en: : We can’t all be perfect. I apologize for my existence and how it may intimidate you.
lines.zh: : 我们不可能都完美。我为自己的存在、以及它可能给你带来的压迫感道歉。

lines.en: : You’ll be the talk of the evening, Kendo Princess. I am now intimately familiar with your body and promise only the best in MacCormack creations from this point on!
lines.zh: : 你今晚绝对会是全场焦点，剑道公主。我现在对你的身体已经了如指掌了，并保证从今往后只提供最顶级的 MacCormack 出品！

lines.en: : Intimately...familiar...
lines.zh: : 了如指掌……

lines.en: : If only it meant what you want it to mean, Nithhala. If only.
lines.zh: : 要是那意思是你想的那样就好了，Nithhala。要是就好了。

lines.en: : So I assume you have...no clue who you’re dressed up as. Do you, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 所以我猜你……完全不知道自己扮的是谁。是吧，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : I have been advised that my character’s name is “Jade” from a video game titled “Moral Combat.”
lines.zh: : 我被告知我的角色名叫「Jade」，出自一款名为「Moral Combat」的电子游戏。

lines.en: : {i}Mortal.{/i} And it’s {i}Kombat{/i} with a K. Not a C.
lines.zh: : 是 {i}Mortal{/i}。而且 {i}Kombat{/i} 是 K 开头，不是 C。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow29
: How can you even tell the-
lines.zh: : 你怎么能看出那——

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow30
: Oh my {i}fucking{/i} god. I forget what I was even saying.
lines.zh: : 哦我{i}操{/i}。我都忘了自己刚才在说什么了。

lines.en: : Likely something about how impressive my skills are. And how they continue to improve with each passing Halloween.
lines.zh: : 大概是在说我的手艺有多厉害吧。以及它们如何随着每一个万圣节不断进步。

lines.en: : I no longer prefer Kitana.
lines.zh: : 我不再最喜欢 Kitana 了。

lines.en: : You really {i}have{/i} been improving, Molly. Though, I would like to ask why you’re the only one of our cosplay group this Halloween who’s dressed in casual clothes as opposed to combat ones.
lines.zh: : 你的手艺{i}确实{/i}一直在进步，Molly。不过我想问一句，为什么今年我们这个 cosplay 小队里只有你穿便服，而不是战斗服。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow31
: Futaba’s combat clothes are just so boring!
lines.zh: : Futaba 的战斗服实在太无聊了！

lines.en: : That’s very rude to say directly to her face.
lines.zh: : 当着人家的面这么说很失礼。

lines.en: : They’re totally unnecessary too since she never even engages in combat!
lines.zh: : 而且完全没必要，因为她根本从来不参加战斗！

lines.en: : Your defamatory barrage continues despite the fact that it puts one of your friendships in jeopardy. I implore you to reconsider, even if you are correct.
lines.zh: : 尽管你的诽谤炮火正危及你们其中一段友谊，你却仍在继续。我恳请你重新考虑，即便你是对的。

lines.en: : {i}Oh my fucking god...{/i}
: Can’t I just wear these instead? Form-fitting clothes don’t look good on me when I have zero {i}form{/i} to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我就不能穿这些吗？反正我本来就没{i}身材{/i}，紧身衣穿在我身上也不好看。

lines.en: : I don’t have a problem with it. It’s only fair that you use Halloween as an excuse to dress up as whatever character you want since you’re the one who makes all of our costumes in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。毕竟所有人的服装都是你做的，你借万圣节这个机会扮成任何你想要的角色也很公平。

lines.en: : Maybe...don’t sexualize Tsuneyo as much next year, though.
lines.zh: : 不过……明年别把 Tsuneyo 弄得那么色情了。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow32
: My entire existence is sexual. I am lust incarnate. I {i}am{/i} the Mortal Wombat.
lines.zh: : 我的整个存在就是色情。我是欲望的化身。我{i}是{/i} Mortal Wombat。

lines.en: : {i}Kombat.{/i} And you’re not opposed to dressing this way — are you, Jade?
lines.zh: : 是 {i}Kombat{/i}。而且你并不排斥这么穿——对吧，Jade？

lines.en: : Not at all. I exist to be praised and worshipped.
lines.zh: : 完全不排斥。我存在的意义就是被赞美、被崇拜。

lines.en: : I was thinking less of Tsuneyo herself and...more of the {i}danger{/i} it puts Rin in. She looks like she’s about to pass out.
lines.zh: : 我想的不是 Tsuneyo 本人，而是……这给 Rin 带来的{i}危险{/i}。她看起来快晕过去了。

lines.en: : {i}Oh my fucking god...{/i}
scene chikayumihallow33
: She won’t be in danger much longer at least. Tsuneyo isn’t going to be with us for most of the party.
lines.zh: : 至少她不会有太久的危险。Tsuneyo 大部分派对时间都不会跟我们在一起。

lines.en: : What?! No! She can’t leave! I have to...discuss things with her! About...uhh...noodles?
lines.zh: : 什么？！不行！她不能走！我得……跟她讨论事情！关于……呃……面条？

lines.en: : As tempting as that offer may be, I have come here today to hone my skills as a cook and will be spending the evening in the kitchen.
lines.zh: : 尽管这个提议很诱人，但我今天来是为了磨炼厨艺，整个晚上都会在厨房度过。

lines.en: : Ayane’s butler is apparently a world renowned chef and has agreed to power-level Tsuneyo’s cooking.
lines.zh: : Ayane 家的管家似乎是世界级名厨，已经答应给 Tsuneyo 的厨艺强力升级。

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian has even provided me with special “heirloom underwear” that will boost my XP by 10%%.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者甚至还给我准备了特殊的「传家内裤」，能让我的经验值提升 10%%。

lines.en: scene chikayumihallow34
: {i}They don’t need to know about that part, Kendo Princess.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这部分就不用让他们知道了，剑道公主。{/i}

lines.en: : Molly...what are you making Tsuneyo wear beneath her costume?
lines.zh: : Molly……你到底让 Tsuneyo 在服装底下穿了什么？

lines.en: : Yeah! Show us! It’s only fair!
lines.zh: : 对！给我们看看！这才公平！

lines.en: : {i}See? This is why I told you to keep that part a secret.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}看吧？所以我才叫你把那部分保密。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
: I apologize for my insubordination. I am no longer deserving of the heirloom underwear. I shall remove them now.
lines.zh: : 我为我的违命道歉。我不再配得上那条传家内裤了。我现在就脱下来。

lines.en: : N-Not in the middle of the room! What do you think you’re doing?!
lines.zh: : 别、别在屋子中间脱！你以为你在干什么？！

lines.en: : No, what do {i}you{/i} think you’re doing?! Don’t stop her! Molly, help me hold Futaba back!
lines.zh: : 不，{i}你{/i}以为你在干什么？！别让她停下！Molly，帮我按住 Futaba！

lines.en: : Roger! Engaging vice grip!
lines.zh: : 收到！启动钳制！

lines.en: : Tsuneyo! No stripping in the middle of the party! Rin! Molly! What do you think you’re-
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo！不许在派对中间脱衣服！Rin！Molly！你们以为你们在——

lines.en: : Phantom Thieves! Palace security has reached 99%%! We’re about to be kicked from the dungeon!
lines.zh: : 怪盗团！宫殿警戒度已达 99%%！我们要被踢出迷宫了！

lines.en: : They removed that in Royal! If we turn back the clock, I literally won’t exist anymore!
lines.zh: : 他们在《皇家版》里把那个删了！如果我们把时钟倒回去，我就会字面意义上地不复存在！
